Mr. Atul Kumar Bansal, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Yogesh Pandey, Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand/respondents.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Since common questions of law and fact are involved in these writ petitions, therefore are being taken up together and are being decided by this common judgment.
However, for the sake of brevity, facts of Writ Petition (M/S) No. 641 of 2023 alone are being considered.

A notification was issued under Section 3A of National Highways Act, 1956 by Ministry of Road Transport and Highways on 04.04.2022, declaring its intention to acquire certain plots of land situate in Tehsil Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

entities.text: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Certain persons filed objection to the said notification; while, petitioner in his objection stated that he be informed the extent to which his land is being acquired.
The competent Authority, Land Acquisition decided the objections, vide order dated 30.11.2022 and held that petitioner's land is not affected by acquisition.
Petitioner has challenged the said decision taken by Competent Authority.
He relies upon a report submitted by revenue authorities in 2019 to show that his land is being affected by acquisition.
Merely because petitioner's land was proposed to be acquired initially, will not confer any right upon him, to claim compensation.

WPMS/577/2023 on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132721103/
1
The Competent Authority has dropped petitioner's holding from acquisition proceedings, as is apparent from final notification dated 14.03.2023, issued under Section 3D of National Highways Act, 1956.
Thus, there is no scope for interference with the impugned order, whereby objections filed against preliminary notification under Section 3A of the aforesaid Act were decided.
Accordingly, writ petitions are dismissed.
However, it is made clear that no construction shall be raised on petitioners' land, without first initiating acquisition proceedings.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 21.03.2023 Navin WPMS/577/2023 on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132721103/
